device_entry.description: 用于 Newport XPS 型号 D 控制器的非物理 SFTP 文件交互组件。它在实验系统中负责连接远程文件服务、切换目录、读取文本文件、上传内容、下载文件以及进行基础文件管理，常用于配置文件、脚本和日志的交换。
device_entry.description_en: A non-physical SFTP file interaction component for Newport XPS model D controllers. It is used in lab systems to connect to the remote file service, change directories, read text files, upload content, download files, and perform basic file management, typically for exchanging configuration files, scripts, and logs.
